text.p: Following are the main stories from Thursday morning's Slovenian newspapers:
- Parliament votes on whether to approve the new cabinet of prime minister-designate Janez Drnovsek. Vote starts at 0900 GMT.
- Opposition parties said they would not support Drnovsek's new cabinet.

- The Nationalist Party said it would file a proposal for a referendum to decide whether the government should determine the maximum amount of forest areas that can be returned to former owners, who lost them in the nationalisation process after World War Two.
- Over 60 percent of Slovenians want a referendum on the return of nationalised forest areas to previous owners.
